summary.tldr: Creates a new immigration inadmissibility ground for sanctions and updates related rules in the IRPA, Citizenship Act, Emergencies Act and immigration regulations.
what_it_does: Creates a separate inadmissibility ground for sanctions, covering people blocked by international sanctions Canada follows and people subject to orders or regulations under the Special Economic Measures Act or Magnitsky law.

Updates related Immigration and Refugee Protection Act rules so sanctions are treated separately from other inadmissibility grounds, including rules on family members, detention, removal, appeals and refugee claims.
Limits humanitarian and compassionate requests, and ministerial exemptions, for people inadmissible under security, human or international rights, sanctions or organized crime grounds.
Transfers authority to issue a removal order for sanctions-based inadmissibility from the Immigration Division to the Minister of Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness under the regulations.
Applies the new sanctions ground to some sanctions decisions and orders already in force when the bill receives royal assent.
who_it_affects: The Minister of Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness
summary.background: The bill amends the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act. It also makes related changes to the Citizenship Act, the Emergencies Act and the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations.
